## State and failure coverage

- `application-startup-shutdown` — states: construct services; register owner contributions; open initial window; flush and release on shutdown; failures: Missing database, service initialization failure, window creation failure, interrupted shutdown
- `command-palette-discovery` — states: open; query/filter; select; submenu; execute/dismiss; failures: Empty result, stale provider snapshot, missing handler, execution failure
- `editor-file-lifecycle` — states: open; edit; dirty; save; conflict/read-only; close; failures: Unreadable file, read-only target, write failure, external conflict, language-server failure
- `error-cancellation-recovery` — states: start; progress; failure/cancel; notify; retry/recover; failures: I/O, process, network, parse, permission, stale session, cancellation
- `explorer-files` — states: load; expand/navigate; select; open/preview/terminal; refresh/error; failures: Missing root, permission error, stale async result, remote disconnect
- `git-source-control` — states: discover repository; refresh status; inspect diff; switch branch; recover failure; failures: No repository, command failure, conflict, remote failure, stale status
- `keymap-editing` — states: load; filter; record keystroke; detect conflict; save/reset; reload externally; failures: Malformed file, unknown command, conflict, write failure, external change
- `mcp-agent-session` — states: authenticate; grant; list; act; activity; revoke/expire; failures: Invalid token, missing grant, blocked host, missing credential, timeout, closed session
- `notification-lifecycle` — states: draft; publish/dedupe; unread; read/expand; dismiss/clear; failures: Duplicate burst, stale action identifier, statusbar unavailable
- `project-workspace-transition` — states: Empty -> Project; Standalone -> Project; Project -> Standalone; persist identity; failures: Missing root, denied path, stale session, failed restore
- `settings-and-reload` — states: load; edit; validate; save; watch/reload; migrate/ignore unknown; failures: Malformed JSONC, invalid value, permission/write failure, migration mismatch
- `sftp-browsing-and-transfer` — states: connect; read directory; navigate/search; start transfer; progress/cancel/complete; failures: Authentication, permission, stale directory, cancellation, remote disconnect
- `ssh-host-connection` — states: select host; authenticate; trust/reject; connect; reconnect/disconnect; failures: Unknown host, blocked agent access, missing credential, trust rejection, timeout
- `standalone-terminal` — states: create PTY; ready; running; exit/restart; close; failures: PTY spawn failure, process exit, output interruption, cancellation
- `themes-and-icon-themes` — states: discover; preview; activate; persist; recover invalid selection; failures: Invalid catalog entry, persistence failure, incompatible theme data
